comment: Conformance pack cases this engine renders differently from the spec model, one entry per cause with its open ticket. See test/conformance-pack.test.ts.

entries.cause: untriaged day-one drift in the lazy family
untriaged day-one drift in the notes family
untriaged day-one drift in the ownership family
untriaged day-one drift in the roundtrip family
an indented plus in a note body absorbs a following quote that belongs to the document
bare same-kind word delimiters follow the current spec ahead of this pin
a lazy marker line without the quote prefix past a quote: the model ends the item or keeps the prefix as text
a mention or tag name holds an ASCII letter; engine follows current spec ahead of this pin
an unresolved footnote reference keeps its attribute run as text; engine follows current spec ahead of this pin
